newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases but tight avails limit losses.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases but tight avails limit losses.

text.p: NWE naphtha eased a little as crude dipped in late Friday trade but tight prompt avails limited losses and trade was thin as buyers and sellers stood apart.

Specific grade, date and delivery point buying interest continued to support high paraffinic through to full range naphtha but prices for reforming grades were seen coming under pressure as poor margins limit demand from refiners.

The 60kt Algerian cargo that has been on offer all week at cif high +$3 may now be taken transatlantic according to the holder Petrobras after failing to find a buyer at a suitable level. --Colin Wooster, London Newsroom, +44 171 5642 7456
